targets.extraction_source: CalculiX DAT and STA accepted-increment history
targets.fem_observable: BOLT_PRETENSION_REFERENCE RF1 at every accepted increment
targets.notes: The corrected deck commanded -250 N, -500 N and -750 N, but no equilibrium increment was accepted. The commanded deck contract is verified; the accepted physical force ramp is not.

targets.fem_observable: Maximum absolute component of HEAD_MEMBER_SUPPORT_BAND total reaction
targets.notes: No accepted equilibrium state exists from which a governed external-support reaction can be extracted.

targets.extraction_source: CalculiX DAT and STA accepted final increment
targets.fem_observable: BOLT_PRETENSION_REFERENCE RF1 at accepted step time 1.0
targets.notes: The corrected 750 N smoke model diverged before its first accepted increment. The governed 5 kN final preload was therefore not reached.

targets.fem_observable: Section-averaged axial stress over a governed threaded bolt section
targets.notes: No accepted physical pretension state exists. Stress values from unconverged Newton iterations are not admissible verification evidence.
targets.quantity: Nominal bolt tensile stress at 5 kN

targets.extraction_source: CalculiX FRD displacement field at accepted increments
targets.fem_observable: Preload increment divided by governed bolt reference-plane elongation
targets.notes: The corrected nonlinear model produced no accepted preload-displacement state. Bolt stiffness cannot be calculated from unconverged iteration fields.

targets.extraction_source: CalculiX FRD displacement field at accepted increments
targets.fem_observable: Preload increment divided by governed member-stack shortening
targets.notes: The corrected nonlinear model produced no accepted member-compression state. Member stiffness cannot be verified.

targets.fem_observable: First governed loss of compressive member-interface contact under external separation loading
targets.notes: A preload-only smoke simulation cannot observe joint separation. A stabilised preload state and dedicated external-separation simulation are required.

targets.extraction_source: Dedicated contact-output simulation with per-turn flank groups
targets.fem_observable: Integrated normal contact force on turn 1 divided by total engaged-thread flank force
targets.notes: The current deck does not request governed per-turn integrated contact forces. A stabilised contact solution and dedicated per-turn output groups are required.
